I set up the job, but it is not running yet, and its next run time looks wrong.

- **Gateway not running:** the scheduler reported that the Hermes gateway is not running, so the job is saved but will not fire until the gateway is started.
- **Next run time:** the job shows its next run as Monday 26 Oct. Today, 14 Oct, is a Wednesday, so the first run should be today at 17:30. Someone should check the schedule before relying on it.
- **Delivery:** the job is local-only, so its output will not be posted into #strategic-pod by itself. If you want it to post there, it needs to be set up with a delivery target that connects to the channel.

I replied in the thread on your message to say the job is set up but not yet active.
